selection.rule: First pseudonymous ID with 28 consecutive calendar days each >=130 valid slots; earliest such window

time_definition.note: Timezone not encoded/confirmed. All displayed times use original naive timestamps; not asserted KST.
time_definition.activity_definition: Activity_IR > 0; research proxy, not PIR ON/OFF or waking time

recommendation.formula: p90(first observed Activity_IR > 0 per calendar day in baseline) + 30 minutes

fixed.basis: Explicit experimental common fixed 09:00; not clinical standard, not optimized

validation.window_quality_rule: At least 90% valid expected 10-min slots from 00:00 to cutoff inclusive; longest missing run <=2 slots; last expected slot observed. Insufficient -> unverifiable before classification.
validation.normal_definition: Proxy activity observed by cutoff; does not establish safety/normal health

limitations: First calendar-day motion is not waking time; nighttime motion makes the 03:09-type threshold unsuitable as an established morning check.
Observed first activity can be later than true activity when earlier slots are missing; missing is never treated as zero.
Sleep/outing labels are annotations rather than independent evidence of state or risk; no causal attribution from this case.
Single household and 14 held-out days cannot establish emergency detection accuracy or reduction of false alerts.
